description: Adds a tool group to this agent: alerts (alerts, incidents, channels), feedback_and_docs (page notes, feedback, docs), environments_and_storage (domains, internal apps, git credential, buckets, destroying or restarting an environment, proposing a private destination, linking apps privately, reading MikroTik sites, the network entry points and egress), administer (members, groups, roles, access, tokens, service accounts, bindings, usage, project settings and deletion, organization settings), connections (calling a connection's API, writes included), functions (trying the function in front of a connection), data_relays (reading and writing a customer's private databases and APIs through its data relay).
name: load_tools
title: Load a tool group
